Shadow of the Horned Rat, Chaos Gate, Dark Omen, Fire Warrior and more have returned!

Warhammer Classics is a collection of much-loved titles from Warhammer video game history, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. 

All of these games are available right now on the Warhammer Classics Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/warhammer/sale/warhammer-classics
